vidmap.outputRepresentation: Global SE(3) camera poses and sparse points
vidmap.coordinateFrame: Global reconstruction frame with similarity gauge anchored by learned metric-depth priors
vidmap.scale: Monocular metric-depth prediction regularizes scale; this is not measured depth or guaranteed sensor-grade metric accuracy
vidmap.temporal: Offline / non-causal: multiple extraction passes and global optimization after seeing the sequence
vidmap.evaluation: LaMAR 50 phone videos, CroCoDL phone/robot sequences, 55 ETH3D-SLAM sequences and 11 EuRoC sequences; calibrated and uncalibrated protocols
vidmap.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
vidmap.implementation: Dense warp chaining, covariance-aware sparse tracks, loop-closure provenance losses and global SfM/BA with depth priors
vidmap.limitations: Heavy extraction and global optimization; geometric precision remains below strict VI tolerances and very long sequences still drift. No direct UMI deployment verified.

slam.metricScale: Learned metric-depth priors; not a measured metric sensor
slam.captureRelevance: Directly evaluates wearable/phone LaMAR and casual videos; potential batch capture backend rather than online VIO replacement.
slam.calibration: Unknown intrinsics can be estimated; timestamps/order and a valid supported camera model still matter.

mp-sfm.summary: Combines monocular depth/normal priors with multi-view geometry when overlap or parallax is weak.
mp-sfm.input: Unordered calibrated images, image matches and inferred monocular depth/normals with uncertainty
mp-sfm.output: Registered camera poses and sparse reconstruction
mp-sfm.supervision: Pretrained monocular depth/normal networks and image matchers plus geometric optimization
mp-sfm.robotEvidence: ETH3D low-overlap triplets/full scenes, SMERF and difficult indoor low-parallax captures; angular relative-pose metrics
mp-sfm.outputRepresentation: Incremental SfM camera poses, points and uncertainty-aware surface constraints
mp-sfm.coordinateFrame: Reconstruction frame; scale depends on the supplied prior model
mp-sfm.scale: Monocular depth/normal priors regularize otherwise ambiguous geometry; no measured depth stream required
mp-sfm.temporal: Offline incremental SfM, not a causal real-time SLAM estimator
mp-sfm.evaluation: ETH3D low-overlap triplets/full scenes, SMERF and difficult indoor low-parallax captures; angular relative-pose metrics
mp-sfm.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
mp-sfm.implementation: Uncertainty propagation, surface-prior residuals, depth-consistency checks, sparse/dense matching and COLMAP-based mapping
mp-sfm.limitations: Over-confident depth uncertainty, unreliable outdoor normals, image retrieval symmetries and extremely low overlap remain limits; added computation. A capture reference, not verified UMI adoption.

slam.metricScale: Inferred monocular surface priors; model-dependent scale
slam.captureRelevance: Useful for sparse wearable capture and low-parallax scene reconstruction; paper is general SfM.
slam.calibration: Original paper assumes calibrated pinhole intrinsics; model/prior choices and their uncertainties require configuration.

egocentric-splats.summary: Uses high-frequency visual-inertial calibration and physical image formation to improve egocentric Gaussian reconstruction.

egocentric-splats.output: Photorealistic Gaussian scene model and rendered views

egocentric-splats.scale: Inherited from visual-inertial MPS; learned rendering does not add an independent depth sensor
egocentric-splats.temporal: Offline per-scene optimization with upstream VIBA; an interactive viewer does not make estimation online
egocentric-splats.evaluation: Indoor/outdoor Aria recordings and Quest 3 validation; PSNR and visual ablations for VIBA, motion sampling and radiometric modeling

egocentric-splats.limitations: Requires upstream MPS/VIBA rather than replacing camera tracking. Primarily static-scene reconstruction, not a new autonomous loop-closing SLAM backend. Mixed-camera example is documented as untested.

slam.metricScale: Metric scale inherited from MPS visual-inertial trajectory
slam.captureRelevance: Wearable scene-reconstruction pipeline consuming upstream MPS/VIBA trajectories; renderer has no native loop-closing backend.
slam.calibration: MPS online RGB intrinsics/extrinsics, rolling-shutter readout and high-frequency trajectory; recommended capture profile caps exposure.

lamaria.summary: Benchmarks wearable VI trajectories with surveyed city-scale control points and an offline pose-refinement toolkit.
lamaria.input: Aria visual/inertial recordings, calibration, surveyed control-point observations and estimated trajectories
lamaria.output: Control-point scores/recall, pseudo-GT pose evaluation and optional visual-inertial refinement
lamaria.robotEvidence: Paper: over 22 h / 70 km, 63 main recordings plus controlled captures; night, moving platforms and time-varying calibration. Dense pseudo-GT has roughly 20 cm aggregate validation accuracy, not the centimeter CP precision.
lamaria.outputRepresentation: Surveyed 3D controls, aligned trajectories and optimized VI pose states
lamaria.coordinateFrame: Survey coordinate system after similarity alignment; dense pseudo-GT is a separate optimized estimate
lamaria.scale: Surveyed metric points constrain evaluation; sparse CP accuracy and dense pseudo-GT accuracy differ
lamaria.temporal: Offline annotation, evaluation and optional VI optimization; benchmark is not itself an online estimator
lamaria.evaluation: Paper: over 22 h / 70 km, 63 main recordings plus controlled captures; night, moving platforms and time-varying calibration. Dense pseudo-GT has roughly 20 cm aggregate validation accuracy, not the centimeter CP precision.
lamaria.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
lamaria.implementation: Sparse CP triangulation/alignment, dense visual-inertial optimization, sequence-format converters and evaluation server
lamaria.limitations: Aria SLAM initializes pseudo-GT; no independent pose-recall claim for that baseline. Moving platforms and sparse controls limit dense-pose guarantees. RGB supplied but paper baselines use global-shutter SLAM cameras.

slam.metricScale: Surveyed metric control points; dense pseudo-GT estimated separately
slam.captureRelevance: Direct egocentric city-scale benchmark for capture trajectory reliability and calibration drift.
slam.calibration: Factory / Aria-estimated time-varying intrinsics are held fixed during VI pose/point refinement; surveyed controls anchor evaluation.

slam.metricScale: Laser-scanner reference map and device-VIO metric scale
slam.captureRelevance: Wearable/handheld localization benchmark with reusable ground-truth generation pipeline; adjacent to manipulation capture.
slam.calibration: Per-frame AR intrinsics, camera-rig extrinsics and tracker trajectory; scan-to-sequence registration.

slam.metricScale: Measured LiDAR ranges plus inertial geometry
slam.captureRelevance: Direct UMI-style wrist-mounted demonstration-processing workflow; gripper hardware remains principally in Awesome-UMI.
slam.calibration: STM32 PPS/pseudo-GPRMC and camera trigger; fisheye intrinsics; LiDAR-camera and camera/TCP extrinsics; aperture calibration.

egomotion-local-loops.summary: Uses repeated views during head sweeps for local loop constraints without depending on noisy 3D rotations.
egomotion-local-loops.output: Camera trajectory and semidense depth maps

slam.metricScale: Monocular arbitrary scale
slam.captureRelevance: Early dedicated head-motion/egocentric estimator; useful historical comparison for why off-the-shelf SLAM fails.
slam.calibration: Monocular intrinsics/distortion; GoPro sequences calibrated, some external sequences approximate.

ego-slam.summary: Solves shaky egocentric motion using global pose averaging and bundle adjustment inside temporal windows.

ego-slam.output: Camera trajectory and sparse point cloud; optional external dense reconstruction

ego-slam.outputRepresentation: Rotation/translation averaged poses, sparse landmarks and window-to-window scale alignment

ego-slam.scale: Absolute metric scale remains ambiguous; trajectory comparison uses seven-degree-of-freedom alignment
ego-slam.temporal: Offline/windowed batch processing; not a modern real-time guarantee
ego-slam.evaluation: Hyperlapse and public egocentric clips; KITTI and TUM additional trajectory comparisons. Dense figure uses external CMVS.
ego-slam.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
ego-slam.implementation: 2D pairwise pose estimation, robust rotation averaging, translation averaging and windowed global BA
ego-slam.limitations: No demonstrated full global-loop/relocalization module; weak overlap and camera calibration remain relevant. Legacy MATLAB/Windows-oriented package is academic/noncommercial only.

slam.metricScale: Monocular arbitrary scale
slam.captureRelevance: Specifically studies shaky egocentric trajectories and poor parallax, rather than using ego-motion to mean automotive motion.
slam.calibration: Camera intrinsics/distortion; sample uses GoPro Hero 4 and OcamCalib.

vins-fisheye.implementation: Fisheye flattening, point tracking, VINS-Fusion-based optimization and optional SGM stereo depth

slam.metricScale: Calibrated stereo baseline plus inertial scale
slam.captureRelevance: Reusable wide-FoV VI reference; relevant to capture-rig design. MILD uses a related modified backbone, not proof of stock-fork accuracy.
slam.calibration: Dual-fisheye camera model, stereo/camera-IMU extrinsics and timing; optional GPU/depth setup.

tagslam.summary: Uses AprilTag factors to jointly estimate camera/body poses and tag maps with optional odometry.

tagslam.output: Camera/body trajectory, tag poses and optional camera extrinsic calibration

tagslam.outputRepresentation: GTSAM graph of rigid bodies, cameras, tags and odometry
tagslam.scale: Known tag dimensions and pose constraints; optional metric odometry
tagslam.temporal: Online or rosbag replay; global graph growth limits real-time use on long mapping sessions
tagslam.evaluation: Original loop-closure and multi-camera examples; MILD includes a single-anchor adaptation with task-dependent failures, not a general validation guarantee
tagslam.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim
tagslam.implementation: Robust graph initialization and AprilTag corner factors with GTSAM; current ROS2 work-in-progress branch alongside older ROS1 documentation

slam.metricScale: Known tag dimensions; optional odometry
slam.captureRelevance: Useful instrumented-workspace localization/reference generation; directly compared in MILD under a specific single-anchor setup.
slam.calibration: Camera intrinsics/distortion, synchronized multi-camera stamps, camera-to-body poses and tag dimensions/anchors.

ucoslam.summary: Combines natural keypoints and planar markers for map building, metric scale and long-term relocalization.
ucoslam.input: Calibrated monocular, stereo or RGB-D images; optional known-size ArUco markers
ucoslam.output: Camera trajectory and reusable keypoint/marker map
ucoslam.robotEvidence: Original paper: KITTI, EuRoC, TUM and SPM; MILD adds close-range fisheye case studies with route-specific calibration/markers
ucoslam.outputRepresentation: Keyframe map with natural landmarks and square planar-marker poses
ucoslam.coordinateFrame: Local map; known marker dimensions can anchor monocular map scale
ucoslam.scale: Monocular keypoints alone have arbitrary scale; known marker size, stereo baseline or measured RGB-D supplies metric scale
ucoslam.temporal: CPU real-time mapping or deterministic sequential offline mode
ucoslam.evaluation: Original paper: KITTI, EuRoC, TUM and SPM; MILD adds close-range fisheye case studies with route-specific calibration/markers
ucoslam.robotPlatform: Capture / reconstruction reference; no robot policy claim

slam.metricScale: Known marker dimensions or stereo/RGB-D; keypoints-only mono remains scale-ambiguous
slam.captureRelevance: Marker-augmented teaching-space reference, explicitly tested in MILD; not guaranteed to transfer unchanged to fisheye UMI motion.
slam.calibration: Camera projection/distortion and known marker sizes; stereo/RGB-D calibration if those modes are used.

unblur-slam.summary: Combines physically constrained deblurring with Gaussian mapping for motion and defocus blur.

unblur-slam.output: Camera poses, sharp views and a Gaussian scene map
unblur-slam.outputRepresentation: 3D Gaussians; per-pixel blur kernels and sub-frame poses
unblur-slam.scale: Monocular geometry and learned depth priors do not supply a sensor-measured metric scale
unblur-slam.temporal: Online tracking and Gaussian mapping; final multiscale refinement after trajectory completion
unblur-slam.supervision: Pretrained visual priors with geometric / photometric optimization
unblur-slam.robotEvidence: ReplicaBlurry, ArchViz, TUM RGB-D, IndoorMCD and Deblur-NeRF; RGB-input modes
unblur-slam.target: Capture camera trajectory and scene context
unblur-slam.evaluation: ReplicaBlurry, ArchViz, TUM RGB-D, IndoorMCD and Deblur-NeRF; RGB-input modes
unblur-slam.robotPlatform: Camera / rig evaluation; not an imitation policy
unblur-slam.implementation: Deblurring frontend, dense tracking with loop closure, and a 3DGS blur-model fallback

slam.metricScale: Monocular geometry and learned depth priors do not supply a sensor-measured metric scale

slam.captureRelevance: Blur is common in head / wrist capture; this is a blur-aware RGB reconstruction reference, not measured action ground truth.

sgad-slam.summary: Uses depth-aligned Gaussian distributions for tracking and pixel-aligned appearance Gaussians for mapping.
sgad-slam.output: Camera trajectory and photorealistic Gaussian map

sgad-slam.scale: Calibrated RGB-D depth anchors metric scale; global frame remains arbitrary
sgad-slam.temporal: Sequential tracking and mapping; optional final refinement

sgad-slam.target: Capture camera trajectory and scene context
sgad-slam.evaluation: Replica, TUM RGB-D, ScanNet and ScanNet++; tracking, rendering and surface reconstruction
sgad-slam.robotPlatform: Camera / rig evaluation; not an imitation policy
sgad-slam.implementation: G-ICP tracking and depth-offset appearance optimization without a pretrained loop detector

slam.metricScale: Calibrated RGB-D depth anchors metric scale; global frame remains arbitrary
slam.calibration: Camera intrinsics, depth units and RGB-to-depth registration; synchronized frames
slam.captureRelevance: Reference for camera-trajectory and scene recovery in human capture; direct adoption in an Ego / UMI product is not asserted.

flow4dgs-slam.scale: Calibrated RGB-D depth anchors metric scale; global frame remains arbitrary

slam.metricScale: Calibrated RGB-D depth anchors metric scale; global frame remains arbitrary
slam.calibration: Camera intrinsics, depth units and RGB-to-depth registration; synchronized frames
slam.captureRelevance: Relevant to moving hands and manipulated objects, but reconstructed motion is not a tactile observation or robot action label.

wildgs-slam.summary: Learns per-pixel uncertainty to remove dynamic distractors while tracking and mapping static scenes.

slam.captureRelevance: Reference for camera-trajectory and scene recovery in human capture; direct adoption in an Ego / UMI product is not asserted.
